He really... really was trying to cut me.

Trying to kill me...

No.

I couldn't believe it.
...Didn't want to believe it.

en.html:
Not now. Don't think.
Don't think about anything.

Start thinking, and it would break—the conviction Father left me.

One thing. Only that one thing I had to keep in mind.
